methodology: Pure runtime camera APIs with compiled USGS source terrain. CSS dimensions are drawing viewports, not full phone screens. No GPU/browser image or geographic acceptance claim.
assertions: Every tactical corner inside inset bounds at the explicit preset
Tactical geometry clears the 64px right control band plus 24px label margin
Stable baseline lens and pivot during drag
Uniform meter scale in exact Top
occupancyMeaning: Bounding-box occupancy, not filled fairway area or geographic accuracy.
limitations: Source candidates require independent geographic approval.
Context, shadows, and illustrative tree crowns may intentionally continue beyond the tactical crop.
This check does not validate device frame rate or browser compositing.
